_doc: The armor model, read by plug-ins/loadsave/tohit.cpp. model 1 turns it on, .toHitModel(0) is the instant brake and .toHitModel(-1) follows this file again. Hit chance: accuracy = base_w x class base + effective hitroll, evasion = ev_level x level + ev_dex x dex x level/100, P = A^hit_pow / (A^hit_pow + E^hit_pow) between p_floor and p_cap. Damage reduction: K = dr_level x victim level + dr_pierce x effective hitroll, x = (armor/K)^dr_pow, share stopped = x/(1+x) up to dr_cap percent. Elemental hits use the exotic column at spell_factor with spell_pierce_level x caster level as effective hitroll. armor_use_bonus: armor per victim level on an armor use success. blind_factor: evasion multiplier against a blind attacker. armor_version: pfile stamp of the armor recompute at login, raise it to rebuild every character once, 0 turns the recompute off. Oracle: reviews/2026-10-30-ac-hitroll-data/c4.py.
